property_summary: For any amount v>0, a successful owner call withdraw(v) must move exactly v wei out of the contract, so the revert-flag/balance pair obeys: either the call reverts or address(c).balance drops by exactly v; the mutant always transfers 0, so successful withdrawals leave the balance unchanged and break the rule.
change_summary: Transfer 0 instead of the requested _value, so withdraw never moves funds.
